questions.text: It is 2026-11-09 and this lost 1R: Brent went through 98.0 first, as random entries with your target and stop did 38.3% of the time. What happened? Name at least one reason that is a thesis error, not luck.

Zweig warns against following the crowd: this idea's source is consensus, while managed money is only at the 17th percentile on your side. What is your own edge here beyond what the consensus already says, and what would make you drop it if the crowd piles in?
